AI Prompt Hero
AI Prompt Hero
@tess/ai-prompt-hero
v1.0.0
verified

Prompt input section with local example prompts and an optional host-provided generation callback. It includes no model or generation service.

Install:
tess add ai-prompt-hero
Registry source: /r/ai-prompt-hero.json
#ai-prompt-hero
#hero
#ai
#prompt
#marketing
VARIANT:
Quiet
Expressive

Motion
Intent
Code
Variants
Anatomy
Accessibility
Performance
Dependencies
Versions
SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Collect a product brief with local example prompts, then optionally pass it to a host-provided callback.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Applications that collect a product brief before a host-defined action
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Standard brochureware sites
JOBS TO BE DONE
Collect a short product brief before a host-defined action
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
Clear hierarchy, responsive layout, a labelled input, and truthful helper text
TARGET PRODUCT ARCHETYPES
marketing-site (95%)
b2b-saas (90%)
developer-tool (85%)

Source and sandbox preview available. Workbench composition is restricted to the validated Gold runtime registry.

npx install
